E1_2.note: tile score u_t = w . z(e_t) (z-scored with the fit's training mean / sd), so the sample logit = b0 + mean_t u_t exactly; contributions = u_t / N (logit units); summaries of the endoscopy's top-H&E sample in each repeat under its outer model; bg = tile with > 50% white pixels (R55); edge = non-background tile with tissue-mask share < 0.8 in its 3 x 3-tile neighbourhood or > 25% white; ink = > 2% saturated green-blue pixels; blur = non-background tile below the 10th percentile of Laplacian variance; gini_pos = Gini of positive contributions; conc_top16_of_pos = share of positive contribution from the 16 highest tiles; check value x 1000
